title: Evaluation-state invariant
statement: Let an evaluation state consist of a phase $\phi$, a Boolean list $vals$, a list $M$ of natural numbers marking tape cells, and a natural-number work-head position $j$. The invariant requires $j\le |vals|$, every $a\in M$ to satisfy $a<|vals|$, and the main-phase predicate of $\phi$ to be true; it also requires $j=0$ whenever the walk-phase predicate of $\phi$ is false.
hypotheses_covered: The main-phase predicate of $\phi$ is true
If the walk-phase predicate of $\phi$ is false, then $j=0$
